title: 第15章 院长遗书仇人登门第16章 没在册那就好办多了
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
院长奶奶还是死了。
常年的操劳再加上常年吃不饱、穿不暖，让她身体差到了极点。
这一次小臂被咬断了，没有得到及时的救治，失血过多，让她的身体机能被绷到了极限。
实际上，这根弦在医院就该绷断的。
要不是心里有股执念，让她想要回到孤儿院，她可能根本走不出那个医院。
陈小草把原本囤起来的物资卖掉大半，换来一口棺材和一套寿衣。
她亲自帮奶奶擦拭身体，换上寿衣，让她在最后的时刻还能干干净净的出现在八小只面前。
陈小花在第二天就吵着闹着要出院，可还是没能看到奶奶最后一面。
此时，八小只在棺材面前跪成一排，哭的昏天黑地。
陈小草在孤儿院大门一侧的小花园里挖着坑。
院长奶奶说过，等她以后去了，就把她埋在这里。
陈小草要守住孤儿院，要守住院长奶奶。
她要让她就在孤儿院的门口，看着她为她报仇！
没错，她要报仇。
从孩子们的嘴里，陈小草认出来伤害奶奶的人，就是那个说要来收回孤儿院的恶心胖子。
咬断奶奶手臂的，就是那个胖子带着的，长了个肿瘤的恶犬！
孤儿院是个人人避之不及的地方。
那些本就过得不好的人，生怕沾染上了孤儿院，院长会去找他们要钱要粮。
所以自打陈小草记事起，院长奶奶就没有什么朋友。

恰恰相反，甚至还会有人跟院长奶奶抢野菜，而起冲突。
她也不觉得会有人来为奶奶吊唁。
挖好坑后，一行九人拼尽力气将院长奶奶安葬下去。
陈小草站在坟前，准备将奶奶的遗物都烧给她。
“对不起，奶奶。”
“是小草没用，小草没能保护好你。”
奶奶的东西并不多，两件薄薄的外套不分四季的穿，补丁打的甚至看不出它原本的样式。
还有一个赤红色，造型怪异的匣子。
陈小草依稀记得，这个匣子在她小的时候还是满的，里面装满了各种各样的首饰。
奶奶曾经拿出来过一个漂亮的棍子，棍子端头有一只活灵活现的蝴蝶。
奶奶告诉她，那叫发钗，等以后她长大了，就把发钗送给她当嫁妆。
小小的陈小草不知道什么是发钗，更不知道什么是嫁妆。
她只知道，那只蝴蝶真的很漂亮。
只不过随着她长大，这个匣子被拿出来的次数越来越少，里面的东西也慢慢变少。
陈小草问过奶奶。
“为什么匣子里的东西不见了，是不是被小偷偷走啦！”
奶奶总是会笑着挠陈小草圆乎乎的肚皮，哈哈笑着说。

Grandma Dean is still dead.
Years of hard work, combined with not having enough to eat and not wearing warm clothes all year round, left her in extremely poor health.
This time her forearm was bitten off, and she did not receive timely treatment. She lost too much blood, which stretched her body functions to the limit.
In fact, this string should have been broken in the hospital.
If it weren't for the obsession in her heart that made her want to return to the orphanage, she might not have been able to leave the hospital at all.
Chen Xiaocao sold most of the supplies he had hoarded in exchange for a coffin and a set of shrouds.
She personally helped grandma wipe her body and put on the shroud, so that she could appear clean in front of the eight little ones at the last moment.
Chen Xiaohua clamored to be discharged from the hospital the next day, but she still didn't get to see her grandma for the last time.
At this time, the eight little ones knelt in a row in front of the coffin, crying their hearts out.
Chen Xiaocao was digging a hole in the small garden on the side of the orphanage gate.
The dean’s grandma said that when she goes there, she will be buried here.
Chen Xiaocao wants to guard the orphanage and the director's grandmother.
She wanted her to stand at the door of the orphanage and watch her avenge her!
Yes, she wants revenge.
From the children's mouths, Chen Xiaocao recognized that the person who hurt grandma was the disgusting fat man who said he was coming to take back the orphanage.
The one who bit off grandma's arm was the vicious dog with a tumor that the fat man was carrying!
Orphanages are places that everyone avoids.
Those who were already living a bad life were afraid that if they got involved in the orphanage, the director would go to them and ask for money and food.
So as long as Chen Xiaocao can remember, Grandma Dean has not had many friends.
On the contrary, there will even be conflicts with the dean's grandmother over the wild vegetables.
She didn't think anyone would come to express condolences for her grandma.
After digging the hole, a group of nine people tried their best to bury the dean's grandmother.
Chen Xiaocao stood in front of the grave, preparing to burn all her grandma's belongings to her.
"I'm sorry, grandma."
"It's Xiaocao that's useless. Xiaocao failed to protect you."
Grandma didn't have many things. She wore two thin coats regardless of the season, and they were so patched that you couldn't even see their original style.
There is also a red, weird-looking box.
Chen Xiaocao vaguely remembered that this box was still full when she was young, and it was filled with all kinds of jewelry.
Grandma once took out a beautiful stick with a vivid butterfly on the end of the stick.
Grandma told her that it was called a hairpin, and when she grew up, she would give it to her as a dowry.
The little Chen Xiaocao didn't know what a hairpin was, let alone what a dowry was.
All she knew was that the butterfly was really beautiful.
But as she grew up, the box was taken out less and less often, and the contents inside gradually became less and less.
Chen Xiaocao asked grandma.
"Why are the things in the box missing? Is it stolen by a thief?"
Grandma would always laugh and scratch Chen Xiaocao's round belly, laughing and saying.
